nodes.label: Undo/Redo via snapshot stacks
nodes.rationale: CanvasManager maintains undoStack and redoStack of CanvasSnapshot records (max 50). captureSnapshot serialises every Layer into a LayerState (WritableImage + metadata); restoreFromSnapshot in LayerManager reconstructs Layer objects from those states. This keeps all canvas history decoupled from live Layer objects.

nodes.label: SRC_OVER pixel compositing
nodes.rationale: snapshotUnscaled() and snapshotComposite() both call compositeVisibleLayerPixels() which walks layers bottom-to-top, applying SRC_OVER with per-layer opacity as effectiveAlpha. A final blendOverWhite pass flattens for export. Kept as manual pixel math so per-layer opacity is honoured correctly.

nodes.label: Float selection lifecycle (IDLE>DEFINING>FLOATING>commit/cancel)
nodes.rationale: When the user draws a marquee and releases, pickup() copies the selected pixels from the active layer into a WritableImage (floatImage), erases the source region, and creates a Selection in FLOATING mode. commit() stamps the float back; cancel() returns pixels to original position; delete() discards the float silently.
